description: Shore excursions for every port of one sailing in one call, in itinerary order: hours ashore at each port, up to three picks that fit the time ashore (with an hour to spare before all aboard) and each port's total. Pass a sailing id from searchCruises, or ship plus sail date. activity and minPrice/maxPrice narrow every port. Use this instead of calling getPortExcursions once per port.

activity.description: A kind of activity, e.g. "scuba", "ATV tours", "snorkeling"; omit for everything

date.description: Sail (departure) date, YYYY-MM-DD; with ship, when there is no sailing id

maxPrice.description: Highest "from" price per person in US dollars, e.g. 145 for "under $145"; omit for no limit

minPrice.description: Lowest "from" price per person in US dollars, e.g. 100 for "over $100"; omit for no limit

sailingId.description: A sailing id from searchCruises results, e.g. "carnival-breeze:2026-09-21:5"

ship.description: Ship name, e.g. "Allure of the Seas"; with date, when there is no sailing id

name: getSailingExcursions
title: Excursions for a sailing
